title: Accessibility + i18n-readiness pass on published modules (WCAG 2.2 AA)
context: All published modules must meet WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards and be i18n-ready for downstream localization (required by the module template). After the M1 modules (pilot-006, versioning-008, provenance-009) are published, a dedicated accessibility and i18n-readiness audit ensures compliance is structural and verified, not aspirational. Any defects found are fixed in the same task. Depends on: pilot-006, versioning-008, provenance-009.
objective: Perform a WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and i18n-readiness audit on all published modules (at minimum pilot-006, versioning-008, provenance-009), document all findings, apply fixes, and commit an audit report confirming all modules are compliant.
acceptanceCriteria: WCAG 2.2 AA audit completed on all published modules; findings documented per module with issue severity and fix applied.
All images have descriptive alt text; figures use a colorblind-safe palette; heading structure (H1/H2/H3) is correct and hierarchical; plain-language conventions followed.
Code blocks have accessible labels; link text is descriptive (not 'click here'); contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.2 AA minimums.
i18n-readiness verified: no hard-coded locale-specific strings (dates, units, currency); UI text is extractable; no directional assumptions in layout.
All accessibility defects found during audit are fixed; fixes verified not to introduce regressions.
Audit report committed to the project repo with DCO sign-off; reviewed and signed off by Educator reviewer.
resources: axe accessibility checker (https://www.deque.com/axe/); Lighthouse accessibility audit
output: An ACCESSIBILITY-AUDIT.md report committed to the project repo documenting findings, fixes applied, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance confirmation for all audited modules; Educator reviewer sign-off.
